info.name: Canoe API v1 Custom Fields API

params.name: ownership_level
params.description: Filters the list of custom fields to a specific level. Valid values: Account, Entity, Fund, Allocation, Term. If omitted, returns custom fields for all levels.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page. Defaults to 100.

items.docs: Returns a list of custom fields available for the authenticated tenant. Optionally filter by ownership_level.
